// stats, eval and where
val df1 = df.groupBy("ctx").agg(sum("val").alias("mval"), count("val").alias("mcount"), approx_count_distinct("id").alias("dcid"), collect_set("id").alias("idset"), first("id").alias("fid"))
val df11 = df1.withColumn("nval", round(exp(sin($"mval"))+ $"mcount")).withColumn("v1", concat($"ctx", lit("-s"))).withColumn("rnd", rand()).sort($"mval".desc)
val df2 = df11.filter($"mval" > 21)

// lookup and join
case class Event(ctx: String, out: String)
val lookup = sqlContext.createDataFrame(Event("login", "foo") :: Event("logout", "bar") :: Event("end", "test") :: Nil)
val df3 = df2.join(lookup, Seq("ctx")).withColumnRenamed("out", "v4")

val df4  = df3.withColumn("exid", explode($"idset"))

println("##result##")
df4.toJSON.collect().foreach(println)
